sources.title: Basics of Space Flight: Telecom
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Mars Relay：一次過站的儲存轉送容量
related.titleEn: Mars Relay: store-and-forward capacity of one pass
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 0.125 J/information bit transmitted 與 0.5 J/information bit transmitted，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 0.125 J/information bit transmitted and 0.5 J/information bit transmitted, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋120 decimal MB delivered與80 decimal MB delivered，建立mars_contact.csv、每秒容量累加、150 MB資料守恆帳，並完成以下驗收：規格要求過站後佇列不超50 MB時，600 s通過而400 s失敗；還須驗資料保存與下次排程。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 120 decimal MB delivered and 80 decimal MB delivered; create mars_contact.csv, per-second capacity accumulation and a150 MB data-conservation ledger; apply this acceptance decision: For a post-pass queue limit of50 MB,600 s passes and400 s fails; persistence and the next contact schedule still require evidence.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 固定射頻輸出P時，每送出資訊位元的射頻能量為P/R；這不是接收Eb，也不含放大器效率或太空器全系統能量。 展開基準式 20/160；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：用接觸總能量20000 J除以160000或40000資訊bit，得到同值；再把任何失敗封包從交付bit扣掉另算。 將兩條推導一起存入 voyager_energy.csv、接觸資料量與能量守恆、失敗封包另算表。

從原理 中繼有效容量等於毛資料率乘可用接觸時間與有效比例；一次過站不足時資料必須留在可持續保存的佇列。 展開基準式 2*600*0.8/8；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：獨立用每秒0.2 MB列接觸表；結束剩餘150-120=30或150-80=70 MB，已送加剩餘保持150。 將兩條推導一起存入 mars_contact.csv、每秒容量累加、150 MB資料守恆帳。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from At fixed RF output P, transmit RF energy per information bit is P/R; this is neither received Eb nor total spacecraft energy and excludes amplifier efficiency., expand baseline expression 20/160; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Divide total contact energy20000 J by160000 or40000 information bits; then separately recompute delivered-bit cost after excluding failed packets. Save both derivations with voyager_energy.csv, contact-volume and energy balances, and a separate failed-packet ledger.

Starting from Relay useful capacity is gross rate times usable contact duration times efficiency; data beyond one pass must remain in persistent storage., expand baseline expression 2*600*0.8/8; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Tabulate0.2 MB per second independently; remaining data is30 or70 MB and delivered plus remaining stays150 MB. Save both derivations with mars_contact.csv, per-second capacity accumulation and a150 MB data-conservation ledger.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: G.657 彎曲不敏感光纖：彎曲增量分離
related.titleEn: G.657 bend-insensitive fiber: isolate bend excess loss
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 0.125 J/information bit transmitted 與 0.5 J/information bit transmitted，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 0.125 J/information bit transmitted and 0.5 J/information bit transmitted, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學增量容許1.5 dB；只有0.79 mW組通過，且需恢復測試合格才能歸因彎曲。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching excess-loss limit1.5 dB: only the0.79 mW case passes, provided the restoration control also succeeds.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 固定射頻輸出P時，每送出資訊位元的射頻能量為P/R；這不是接收Eb，也不含放大器效率或太空器全系統能量。 展開基準式 20/160；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：用接觸總能量20000 J除以160000或40000資訊bit，得到同值；再把任何失敗封包從交付bit扣掉另算。 將兩條推導一起存入 voyager_energy.csv、接觸資料量與能量守恆、失敗封包另算表。

合成直線功率1 mW，彎曲後0.79 mW；第二組0.50 mW；同一跳線且不改接頭。 名義式 10*log10(1/0.79) = 1.02373 dB；變更式 10*log10(1/0.5) = 3.0103 dB。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 將彎曲恢復為直線並重讀1 mW；用相對比值消除穩定耦合損耗，再用獨立功率計核對。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from At fixed RF output P, transmit RF energy per information bit is P/R; this is neither received Eb nor total spacecraft energy and excludes amplifier efficiency., expand baseline expression 20/160; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Divide total contact energy20000 J by160000 or40000 information bits; then separately recompute delivered-bit cost after excluding failed packets. Save both derivations with voyager_energy.csv, contact-volume and energy balances, and a separate failed-packet ledger.

Synthetic straight reference1 mW; bent readings0.79 and0.50 mW, with the same patch cord and unchanged connectors. Nominal 10*log10(1/0.79) = 1.02373 dB; changed 10*log10(1/0.5) = 3.0103 dB. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Restore the straight condition and recover1 mW; use ratios to cancel stable coupling loss and cross-check with an independent power reading.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
